title: Transport Management Plans (TMPs)
summary: This page explains what a Transport Management Plan (TMP) is and when it is required for oversize and/or overmass (OSOM) journeys on NSW roads.
intro:
A Transport Management Plan (TMP) – PDF describes how an oversize and/or overmass (OSOM) journey will be managed on NSW roads.

The purpose of the plan is to ensure that journeys are carried out in a safe and responsible manner and with minimum impact on other road users and road infrastructure.

faqs.q: What is a Transport Management Plan (TMP)?
faqs.a: A Transport Management Plan (TMP) describes how an oversize and/or overmass (OSOM) journey will be managed on NSW roads.
A TMP is required for all OSOM movements.

faqs.q: Do I need special approval if I cross a railway?
faqs.a: If you are travelling over a railway crossing, you will also need Rail Infrastructure Manager (RIM) approval.
